environment.postgres: PostgreSQL 18.0 (package build 18.0-2); local isolated databases with _test suffix
environment.database_role: app role symphony_app for authenticated API/browser reads; test-admin role only for synthetic fixture setup/cleanup

commands.command: npm run test:api (Fastify/PostgreSQL; verified-finding route and persisted session path)
npm run test:wp6.1 (served Playwright; all nine workflow contexts)
npm run test:wp6.1:bdd (live browser/API/PostgreSQL Cucumber; 12 scenarios, 71 steps; BDD-UXW-001–004)

claims.behavior_proved: The real served workspace derives nine workflow contexts from authenticated persisted WP2.2 facts and renders their exact navigation. BDD-UXW-001–004 pass through a live Cucumber browser/API/PostgreSQL run: 12 scenarios and 71 steps, including all nine frozen UXW-001 examples, route focus/back/forward/query persistence, a nonempty route inventory and DOM vocabulary scan, and persisted positive verified provenance. Only exact supports_claim with a completed assignment, matching evidence version, scope, immutable official appointment snapshot and exact cooperative_internal assurance renders the positive chip.
claims.path_proved: The dedicated runner starts Fastify and Vite, validates local _test PostgreSQL URLs, seeds synthetic rows through test-admin, establishes real WP5.3 sessions via the login API, and reads workspace/finding data through symphony_app. The retained Cucumber JSON report records every required scenario and all steps passed. UXW-004 negative fixtures cover does_not_support_claim, inconclusive, NULL legacy outcome, missing scope, unsupported assurance, missing attribution, an assignment with no finding, and PostgreSQL rejection of a mismatched assignment/evidence-version finding.
claims.configuration_proved: Node v26.7.0, npm 12.2.0, PostgreSQL 18.0, DATA_MODE=test; local _test databases; symphony_app for runtime reads and test-admin only for setup/cleanup; local-test key provider.
coverage_limitations: This record distinguishes implementation and focused acceptance from exact-candidate gate verification; both exact-candidate verifier modes passed and are retained below.
The fixture seeds synthetic verified findings administratively; a product finding-authoring/write lifecycle is not implemented or claimed by WP6.1.
The /coop/:cooperativeId shell and finding projection enforce current persisted context/tenant scope; unrelated tenant-specific directory and other business-record workflows remain outside this task.
Member activity/household persistence, authority grant/revoke lifecycle and a first-class cohort lifecycle remain the explicit WP2.2 limitations.
Production hosting/data, legal record-classification and public inspection fee workflows, production accessibility review and independent security review are not claimed.
The integrated 41-scenario REM-WP7.2 gate remains downstream and was not run as WP6.1 acceptance.

The aggregate test:bdd:phase1 runner now executes BDD-UXW-001–004 through the live WP6.1 browser/API/PostgreSQL runner and merges that report with default-profile results. The aggregate currently remains failing on other frozen scenarios: BDD-ENR-004, BDD-AUD-001/002/003/005/014 and BDD-UXW-015 fail; BDD-AUD authorization steps remain undefined; BDD-PRV-008/015/016/018/019/020, BDD-UNI-001/002, BDD-AUD-004/007/015 and BDD-UXW-005/009/010/011/013 remain filtered or @wip. UXW-015 is owned by WP6.3.
